label: Apple Watch Ultra 2
description: 49 mm titanium Apple Watch Ultra 2: the radio set is Wi-Fi 4 (802.11n) on 2.4 and 5 GHz, Bluetooth 5.3, second-generation Ultra Wideband, L1+L5 dual-frequency GPS, and an LTE/UMTS modem on the GPS + Cellular SKU. It has no wired interface of any kind - charging is magnetic and there is no USB or Ethernet connector - so Wi-Fi or LTE is the only way onto the network.
notes: Apple's Connectivity block reads 'LTE and UMTS, L1+L5 Precision dual-frequency GPS, Wi-Fi 4 (802.11n), Bluetooth 5.3, Second-generation Ultra Wideband chip'. Apple's Wi-Fi note (https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT204562) adds that the watch joins 802.11b/g/n networks on 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz and will not join public networks that require a login, subscription or profile - it also only auto-joins SSIDs the paired iPhone already knows, which is a genuinely different association model from a laptop. 150M is 1x1 802.11n at 40 MHz; Apple does not publish the LTE UE category, so 100M is a deliberately conservative endpoint figure. No Ethernet, no PoE, no USB.
